main_text.head: SECVNDA PARS METAPHYSICÆ
De Ente communi Corpori & Spiritui.
main_text.p: HÆC secunda pars Metaphysicæ dividitur in tria capita: Primo agitur de Substantia & Accidente: Secundo de Qualitate : Tertio de Relatione. De reliquis prædicamentis agetur in Physicis ; Nam quantitatis est proprietas corporis naturalis necessario tractanda in Physica. Actio & passio tractabuntur in Physicis dum de motu, cum quo sæpius identificantur ; ubi & quando tractabuntur in Physicis dum de loco & tempore : situs verò referetur ad ubi. Habitus sumptus pro veste [?] aut alio adiacente nihil habet notatu dignum.
main_text.head: CAPVT PRIMVM.
De Substantia , & Accidente.
main_text.p: HOc capite agitur primò , de nomine substantiæ & accidentis. Secundò , de definitione substantiæ & accidentis. Tertiò , Inhærentia aptitudinalis impugnatur. Quartò, agitur de suppositο. Quintò, agitur de proprietatibus substantiæ. Sextò, de diuisione hujus ejus[?].

page.notes: The historiated initial H at the start of the first paragraph is a woodcut; its first letter is joined to "Æc" as "HÆC". The "[?]" after "veste" is a doubtful reading of the ligature. "suppositο" ends with a Greek-looking omicron in the scan; it is probably a printing variant of "o" and is kept as printed. The last word of the page, "ejus", is at the bottom edge and partly cut off, so "hujus ejus" is doubtful. Watermark "Digitized by Google" at bottom right omitted.
